author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 바닷가 간사지, 암초, 바다 위, 강어귀, 어장
summary: 흔한 겨울새로, 바닷가 간사지와 암초, 바다 위, 강어귀, 어장 등에서 지낸다. 국내에서는 동해안과 남해안, 낙동강 하구, 한강 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 해안의 작은 언덕이나 풀밭, 작은 섬에 무리 지어 둥지를 짓는다. 세계적으로는 구북구와 신북구 동부, 주로 북위 48~68도 사이에 분포한다.

points.en: greenish-grey to yellow-green bill with a yellow tip

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 크다.

young: 첫겨울 어린새는 머리와 가슴에 갈색 얼룩이 많고 날개덮깃과 셋째날개깃이 갈색이며, 등은 겨울 초에는 갈색이다가 차츰 회색 깃으로 바뀐다. 꼬리 끝에 검은 띠가 있고, 부리는 검으며 기부가 살색이다.

art.subject: Common Gull (Larus canus), adult in winter plumage, of the large East Asian subspecies kamtschatschensis (Kamchatka Gull) that winters in Korea from November to March: white head and neck with grey-brown streaks and smudges, variable in extent, densest around the eye and on the hindneck; back and upperwings medium grey; outer primaries black with large white mirrors and white tips; white trailing edge and white tertial crescent; underparts and tail pure white. Bill slender, greenish-yellow to yellow, brightest at the tip, often with a narrow dark band near the tip. Legs greenish-yellow to yellow.
art.pose: resting on the water at a river mouth, side view
art.scene: Korean river estuary in winter, tidal flats and calm water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter (November–March), side view standing: grey-brown smudged and streaked white head, medium-grey back, black wingtips with white spots, white underparts and tail, slim greenish-yellow bill with yellow tip, greenish-yellow legs
adult breeding (from about March), head detail in profile: clean unstreaked white head, slim yellow-green bill with a yellow tip and no red spot
adult in flight seen from above, head, body and tail in one line: medium-grey upperwing with a white trailing edge, black wingtip with large white mirrors, white rump and tail
art.build: Medium-sized gull, clearly smaller and slimmer than Vega Gull and larger than Black-headed Gull; rounded head, gentle face, slender neck. Bill short and thin for a gull, with only a slight angle on the lower mandible and no red spot. Legs medium length, greenish-yellow. Long wings: at rest the black, white-tipped primaries project well beyond the white tail. In flight medium-grey upperwing with a broad white trailing edge and a black wingtip containing large white mirrors. Tail square and all white.
avoid: Do not paint a red spot on the bill or pink legs — those mark Vega Gull.
Do not paint a black tail band on the adult — that is Black-tailed Gull (Larus crassirostris).
Do not paint a heavy, deep bill or a flat-crowned, fierce head; this gull is gentle-faced and slim-billed.
Do not show a clean white breeding head on birds in a winter scene.
